description: Freediver Club helps athletes and coaches plan, inspect, and log freediving workouts through ChatGPT. It can read profile preferences and workout history, draft structured pool, depth, static, and supporting sessions, create or update workouts, record executed lap and rest data, and let coaches work with consenting athletes in training centers.
